BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BTECH   SEMESTER: V
BRANCH: PROD & IE   SESSION: MO/2022

SUBJECT: PE308 LOGISTICS & SUPPLY CHAIN MANAGEMENT

TIME: 2 HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 25.
2. Candidates attempt for all 25 marks.
3. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
4. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
5. Tables/Data hand book/Graph paper etc. to be supplied to the candidates in the examination hall.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



    CO BL
Q1 (a) Mention the 7R for an effective logistics system.  [2] CO1 1
Q1 (b) Construct a hypothetical supply chain model for a mobile handset OEM. [3] CO1 3


Q2 (a) Differentiate between a closed and open loop supply chain. Cite example.  [2] CO1 2
Q2 (b) Mention and classify all the drivers for supply chain with brief justification.  [3] CO1 2


Q3 (a) How demand management is different from demand forecasting?  [1] CO1 2
Q3 (b) Demand for a part in the present year is 220 units. For the future, Probability of
increase in demand by 30% is 0.75 and that of decrease in demand by 20% is 0.25.
Construct a decision tree to represent three years and find the NPV assuming
INR100 as revenue/unit and a cash discount factor of 10%.
[4] CO1 4


Q4 (a) Explain C2C and C2B business models with one example each.  [2] CO2 3
Q4 (b) Describe about the supply chain distribution network which is preferred for FMCG
and auto manufacturers.
[3] CO2 3


Q5 (a) Inventory aggregation decreases supply chain costs if the product has a high value
to weight ratio. Justify this.
[2] CO2 4
Q5 (b) Briefly explain each acronym: VRPPD; DCVRP; VRPBTW [3] CO2 2
